dialogue_history.content: What are the definitions of low and medium precision?
Low and medium precision are defined by the condition where the Average Position Error (APE) is greater than or equal to 0.1.
What is the definition of a large Robot Age?

A large Robot Age is defined as any robot that has been in operation for more than 1 year. This is calculated using the formula: (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rr.rects - rd.instdateval)) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600)) AS ray, where 'ray' represents the Robot Age in Years.

tool_trajectory.result: Low and medium precision are defined by the condition where the Average Position Error (APE) is greater than or equal to 0.1.

args.question: What is the definition of a large Robot Age?

tool_trajectory.result: A large Robot Age is defined as any robot that has been in operation for more than 1 year. This is calculated using the formula: (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rr.rects - rd.instdateval)) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600)) AS ray, where 'ray' represents the Robot Age in Years.

args.sql:
WITH robot_age AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg, 
        (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rr.rects - rd.instdateval)) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600)) AS ray
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_record AS rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode
),
robot_precision AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.actdetref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN ad.poserrmmval >= 0.1 THEN 'Low/Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS precision_category
    FROM 
        actuation_data AS ad
),
robot_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
        AVG(ad.poserrmmval) AS avg_position_error, 
        MAX(ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
        AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_fault_prediction_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_age AS ra ON rd.botdetreg = ra.botdetreg
    JOIN 
        robot_precision AS rp ON rd.botdetreg = rp.actdetref
    JOIN 
        actuation_data AS ad ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actdetref
    JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    WHERE 
        rp.precision_category = 'Low/Medium' 
        AND ra.ray > 1
    GROUP BY 
        rd.ctrltypeval
)
SELECT 
    controller_type, 
    avg_position_error, 
    max_ape_rank, 
    avg_fault_prediction_score, 
    robot_count
FROM 
    robot_summary
LIMIT 10;

            WHEN ad.poserrmmval >= 0.1 THEN 'Low/Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS precision_category
    FROM 
        actuation_data AS ad
),
robot_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
        AVG(ad.poserrmmval) AS avg_position_error, 
        MAX(ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
        AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_fault_prediction_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_age AS ra ON rd.botdetreg = ra.botdetreg
    JOIN 
        robot_precision AS rp ON rd.botdetreg = rp.actdetref
    JOIN 
        actuation_data AS ad ON rd.botdetreg = ad.actdetref
    JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    WHERE 
        rp.precision_category = 'Low/Medium' 
        AND ra.ray > 1
    GROUP BY 
        rd.ctrltypeval
)
SELECT 
    controller_type, 
    avg_position_error, 
    max_ape_rank, 
    avg_fault_prediction_score, 
    robot_count
FROM 
    robot_summary
LIMIT 10;

WITH robot_age AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg, 
        (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (rr.rects - rd.instdateval)) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600)) AS ray
    FROM 
        robot_details AS rd
    JOIN 
        robot_record AS rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode
),
robot_precision AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.actdetref, 
        CASE 
            WHEN ad.poserrmmval >= 0.1 THEN 'Low/Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS precision_category
    FROM 
        actuation_data AS ad
),
robot_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
        AVG(ad.poserrmmval) AS avg_position_error,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rd.ctrltypeval ORDER BY ad.poserrmmval DESC) AS ape_rank,
        MAX(ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
        AVG(mf.faultpredscore) AS avg_fault_prediction_score, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT rd.botdetreg) AS robot_count
    FROM

    JOIN 
        maintenance_and_fault AS mf ON rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
    WHERE 
        rp.precision_category = 'Low/Medium' 
        AND ra.ray > 1
    GROUP BY 
        rd.ctrltypeval, ad.poserrmmval

SELECT
